title: Speed up board queries with indexes
body:
The board endpoint takes 900 ms on a brief with 20k tasks. Profiling shows full scans of tasks by (brief_id, status) and of messages by (thread_kind, thread_id).

- Add the two indexes as a schema migration in both the SQLite and the Postgres store; the migration must be idempotent and run on startup.
- Add a Go benchmark that seeds 20k tasks and measures the board query before and after; target p95 under 50 ms.
- A tester verifies the migration on a copy of a production-sized database and that a downgrade does not break reads.

repos.name: SigmaUno/subspace
repos.description: Go server; internal/store/sqlite and internal/store/postgres implement the Store interface

requirements.title: Add task and message indexes as an idempotent migration
Benchmark the board query on 20k tasks
Verify the index migration on a production-sized database copy
